name: Monstro
description: A large, cleft-lipped biological mishap that attacks by leaping and vomiting blood.
attack_patterns: Leaps high into the air and lands on the player's position
Vomits a large cluster of blood projectiles
Performs short hops towards the player

name: The Duke of Flies
description: A bloated, floating corpse infested with flies that it spawns defensively.
attack_patterns: Coughing motion that pushes flies outwards

name: Gemini
description: Two conjoined fetuses; one large (Suture) and one small (Contusion), tethered by an umbilical cord.
attack_patterns: Large twin chases the player slowly
If the large twin dies, the small one enrages and charges rapidly

name: Larry Jr.
description: A segmented worm-like boss that moves erratically and can defecate poop obstacles.
attack_patterns: Moves rapidly in straight lines, turning upon hitting walls
Spawns poop pickups when destroying poop obstacles

name: Famine
description: One of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Withers and decays.
attack_patterns: Phase 2: Head detaches and shoots triple shots while body attacks

name: Steven
description: A variant of Gemini, darker in color with a more aggressive small twin.
attack_patterns: Little Steven detaches immediately to hunt the player

name: Baby Plum
description: A cute but deadly bouncing plum-like creature.
attack_patterns: Rapidly bounces diagonally around the room
Spins creating a ring of projectiles

name: Little Horn
description: A small demon that uses magical troll bombs and teleportation holes.
attack_patterns: Shoots a ball of dark energy (instakill projectile for enemies)

name: Pin
description: A segmented worm that burrows into the ground and leaps out.
attack_patterns: Burrows and leaps out at player location
Shoots 4 projectiles in cardinal directions upon surfacing

name: Widow
description: A large spider that jumps and spawns spider enemies.

name: The Haunt
description: A ghostly face attached to the back wall, protected by Lil' Haunts.
attack_patterns: Phase 1: Three invulnerable Lil' Haunts attack

name: Dingle
description: A poop monster that whistles and dashes.

name: Gurdy
description: A stationary pile of guts that spawns enemies and shoots.

name: Mega Fatty
description: A massive, extremely obese version of a Fatty.
attack_patterns: Quick leap slams causing rock waves
Sucks player in with vacuum breath
Farts, pushing player away and dealing damage

name: Peep
description: A bloated yellow monster whose eyes pop out to float around the room.
attack_patterns: Eyes detach and bounce around the room (invincible)

name: Chub
description: A large maggot that charges horizontally.
attack_patterns: Can eat bombs thrown in its path

name: Bumbino
description: A giant Bum Friend that wants coins.
attack_patterns: Will prioritize picking up coins over attacking

name: The Stain
description: A skinned version of Polycephalus.
attack_patterns: Burrows and pops up with tentacles

name: The Forsaken
description: A black skeletal bony boss.

name: The Frail
description: A skeletal version of Pin, with a second phase.
attack_patterns: Phase 1: Burrows and shoots like Pin
Phase 2: Hangs from ceiling and shoots Brimstone lasers

name: The Husk
description: A dead Duke of Flies, filled with spiders.

name: Mom
description: Isaac's mother. Only her foot and organs are visible from above.
attack_patterns: Foot stomp from above (telegraphed by shadow)

name: The Bloat
description: A more horrifying version of Peep. Widely hated.
attack_patterns: Instant dual Brimstone lasers (side and downwards)
Jumps and leaves large creep puddles

name: Mask of Infamy
description: A giant heart protected by an invulnerable mask.
attack_patterns: Must damage the heart from behind (Phase 2)

name: Loki
description: A red demon baby.

name: The Cage
description: A posthumous version of Mega Fatty, dried and rolling.

name: The Adversary
description: A posthumous version of Dark One wrapped in bandages.

name: Carrion Queen
description: A pink, more difficult version of Chub.
attack_patterns: Spawns red poop (damages on touch and regenerates)

name: The Matriarch
description: A Chub stuffed with a Fistula stuffed with various other bosses. Chaos.

name: Mom's Heart
description: The heart of Mom. Beat it to progress.

name: It Lives
description: The fetus version of Mom's Heart. Replaces Heart after 11 kills.

name: Isaac
description: Isaac himself, crying in the holy light.
attack_patterns: Phase 2: Light beams from sky (Holy Light)
Phase 3: Crack the Sky light beams across room

name: Satan
description: The lord of darkness.
attack_patterns: Phase 2: Statue shoots cardinal brimstone and bullet hell
Phase 3: Stomping hooves from above (legs only)

name: Blue Baby
description: The suffocated version of Isaac (???).

name: The Lamb
description: A skeletal demon lamb.
attack_patterns: Detaches body from head in Phase 2

name: Mega Satan
description: The ultimate evil behind the golden door.
attack_patterns: Summons Harbinger bosses and Super Sins

name: Hush
description: A massive suffocated face in the ground.

name: Delirium
description: The hallucination of a dying mind. Transforming chaos.

name: Mother
description: The reanimated corpse of Mom. The final boss of the Alt Path.

name: Dogma
